# Chess Hatch

Chess Hatch is a free chess learning platform for complete beginners
through intermediate players. It is not monetized and is currently in
closed beta.

## What it does

- An "Intermediate" bot ladder gives a new player a progression path:
  start at Beginner and unlock each stronger bot level by winning
  against the current one. The level names are game progression
  labels, not official FIDE ratings or titles.
- Step by step lessons cover how each piece moves, piece values,
  trading, checkmate patterns, tactics, and endgame ideas, organized
  into two tiers (complete beginner, intermediate).
- A guided first game walks a total beginner through a short scripted
  mini match with a live coach explaining each move.
- Practice mode lets two people play on one device with live coach
  feedback, or play against an offline computer opponent (Stockfish)
  at one of twelve difficulty levels.
- Live Match is real time chess between two signed in users, with
  time controls and Glicko-2 ratings.
- Puzzle Rush is a timed puzzle streak mode.
- A glossary and a common beginner mistakes page are available as
  standalone reference pages.

## Technical notes

Single page application built with React, Vite, and react-router.
Chess logic runs on chess.js. The board is react-chessboard. The
backend is Supabase (Postgres, Auth, Realtime). The computer opponent
runs Stockfish entirely client side in a Web Worker.

## Contact

Feedback can be left directly in the app through the feedback button
present on every screen.
